listing.name: Pro Evolution Soccer 2017 — PES 2017 Android (Xbox 360 → ARM64 recompilation) (dzakyraf)
listing.summary: Work in progress: a match reportedly runs on a Galaxy S20 FE. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Pro Evolution Soccer 2017 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Europe Xbox 360 disc; default.xex, CPK archives and nxeart; use identical dump for build and phone.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate ARM64 code from the own Europe disc with build.sh, package with Gradle and import matching disc data on Android.

warnings: Work in progress: a match reportedly runs on a Galaxy S20 FE.
